en.hubeali: H 14963 – Aban, from Abu Baseer, who has narrated the following: Abu Abdullahasws having said:

‘Whenever the Rasool Allah<sup>saww</sup> descended from his<sup>saww</sup> she-camel Al-Qaswa, he<sup>saww</sup> would leave its reins upon it. It would go out and come to the Muslims. So this man would give it something, and that man would give it something. So it would not remain without (its hunger) is being satisfied. It entered its head in a tent of Samarat Bin Jundab, so he took hold of a stick and struck it upon its head. So he scratched it. So it went out to the Prophet<sup>saww</sup> and complained to him<sup>saww</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 516. Aban, from a man, who said:
Abu Abdullah (a.s.) has said that: ‘Maryam (as) carried (in her (as)) Isa (as) for nine hours, each hour for a month’.
